The structure of Li₂Mg₂₈Co₂ (reduced formula LiMg₁₄Co) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms in the unit cell across 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Co, Li, and Mg centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg environments spanning Li/Mg/Co coordination. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mg polyhedra as well as edge- and face-sharing between Co and Mg polyhedra.
